works.body:
Hello! I came across your art on Twitter, and I really adore all the Vocaloid drawings!

This got me thinking about the commission.
I would love to commission art of Raphtalia and Wyndia from The Rising of The Shield Hero.
They would be dressing up (or cosplaying) Vocaloid (or UTAU) characters! The character choice is up to you. You can adjust the outfit colors to match the girls, but you don't have to. The characters for the girls to cosplay can be both male or female.
Theme can be whatever you like, dark, tragic, mysterious, romantic, happy, or whatever else you think of. I want you to have fun with the picture, so draw whatever comes to mind!

The girls are of similar age - young adults. Wyndia is smaller.

I'm adding references for the girls with some of my drawings at the end of the link.

Thank you for considering my request.

https://imgur.com/a/IgexrNN

はじめまして、
あなたの素敵なイラストはとても好きです。
私のOCを描いてくれませんか？
キャラ参照は下記のURLをご覧ください。

(シモン) 150cm
シルバーグレーの髪、目は薄い紫色、メガネフレームは白。
人間なのに、耳ような黑髪の毛はぴくぴく動くている。
とても小柄で繊細、色白で柔らかい体付きの男の娘っぽいイメージです。
おとなしいですが、たまに危険を顧みず、好奇心いっぱいの子！
心が通じるの小さなハリネズミを飼う。

【テーマ】(ホワイト・バレンタインデーのお返し)
構図等様々に関してお任せ致します。
細かい設定についてはお好みで調整して構いません。
できれば例の図のハリネズミのお菓子をお返しに使いください。
依頼内容になにか問題があれば再送要請してください。

【使用用途】
自分用の壁紙とアイコン、個人用な印刷などの使用、
他の方への依頼の際に資料として使用させていただくことがあります。
SNS、ネットで公開する時には、先生を注記してから投稿します。
できれば人物の透過やサインなどは別レイヤーに分けていただけると助かります。

ここまでお読み、私のリクエストを考慮していただければ幸いです、本当にありがとうございます。

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1DtuleE16ftJj_NN4q5Zgp8QqvlDRohWe

Hi, I love your art style and would love to commission you!

I am hoping to get an piece of my OC (Zak Shadows) and of my friends Mazushi Kat.

Zak Shadows (193 CM) is a god of the Void who takes up the profession of Plague Doctor. He has black and white Split hair and red eyes and often wears a plague mask. He is mischievous by nature, but is subdued and calm a majority of the time.

Mazushi Kat is short. She is a black haired demon with red eyes and is broke. She is mischievous by nature and has a very unhealthy obsession with Leon S Kennedy from the Resident Evil Series.

If possible, if you can have the two characters hanging out and or Zak giving her a soda, whichever you prefer. There are some potential pose references in the Google Drive that is attached.

Thank you so much for your time and consideration.

Hello! I'd love for you to draw my two characters Tarak and Arjun together. 

Tarak is unfriendly and cold. He criticizes and bullies Arjun a lot. He is a demon that appears when Arjun has sleep paralysis, so he looks intimidating and scary. Tarak has sharp, black fingernails and fangs. Please draw him with a frown or scowl on his face. Tarak is 192 cm.

Arjun is a reserved and pessimistic prince. Arjun has dark circles under his eyes and is usually tired because of his insomnia. Although Arjun is usually annoyed at Tarak, he still depends on Tarak a lot. He usually looks worried, confused, or exhausted. Please note the mole on his neck! Arjun is 168 cm. 

The two of them are lovers. Despite being a demon, Tarak is tasked with being Arjun's bodyguard. Tarak has been watching over Arjun since they were young and now feels a sense of possessiveness over him.

I really liked this previous work of yours!

Nice to meet you!
I saw your wonderful illustration on Twitter from a new creator and I would love to have you draw my original character! I am here to make a request.
The character has a peculiar setting and appearance, but please consider it.
I would like to use the character on Twitter, Discord, SNS, YouTube, etc., introduce him, or use him as an icon, header, etc. for personal use.

Character

Kanae Mutsumura

24 years old, female
Height 216cm
Weight 84 kg (thin type)
First person I
Second person Ms. 00

Pure white skin and hair (albino)
Scars all over. Cleft lip and palate.
Large mouth with jagged teeth.
Face reminiscent of a large carnivore.
Slightly oval eyes with a different color composition on each side.
No eyebrows and long eyelashes. Missing ears.
Asymmetrical, feather-textured hair.
Long, large hands. Ambidextrous, leaning toward left-handedness.
No chest, rather stout and masculine in frame.

Ostensibly a bodyguard, he is an assassin by profession.
With his excellent medical skills and knife handling, he kills his targets with a single blow without causing them any pain.
He is abnormally tall due to a hormone deficiency caused by a childhood head injury, and is rarely seen (or recognized) as a woman by his appearance.
She is weak-minded and easily deceived, but she is serious and quiet, and does not want to harm anyone outside of work.
She has a strong fear of touching or being touched by others, except in the case of medical treatment, rescue, or other emergencies.
He is good with his hands and his only hobby is cooking.
She loves animals, especially raccoon dogs, and uses them as her LINE icon.
She is sensitive to cold and weak to heat, so she likes winter nights and dislikes summer days.
Her dreams are to have children and become a mother, and to open her own restaurant, even if it is small.

Image
